settings.title: GitHub
settings.description: Connect this project to a GitHub repository. Pull requests and commits then move work items forward, and you can open pull requests from a work item.
settings.save_failed: The GitHub settings couldn't be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
settings.saved_placeholder: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.

repository.label: Repository
repository.hint: Owner and name, as in the repository's URL.
repository.invalid: Use the form owner/name, for example truncore/plane.

token.label: Access token
token.hint: A fine-grained token with access to this repository: Contents (read), Pull requests (read and write) and Metadata (read).

webhook_secret.label: Webhook secret
webhook_secret.hint: Paste the same secret into the GitHub webhook. Plane never shows a saved secret again.
webhook_secret.required: Enter or generate a webhook secret.

workflow_mode.label: Workflow mode
workflow_mode.trunk_based_description: Everyone merges small changes into the trunk often. Commits on the trunk that mention a work item update it, and old branches and large pull requests get a warning.
workflow_mode.feature_branches_description: Work happens on longer-lived branches and reaches the base branch through pull requests.

settings.branch_age_limit_days: Warn when a branch is older than (days)
settings.large_pr_lines: Warn when a pull request changes more lines than

mapping.title: Work item states
mapping.fixed_rules: Draft pull requests don't move a work item. A pull request closed without merging keeps the state and adds a comment. Pull requests only move work items forward.

test.success: Connected to {repository}. Plane can see the repository and the {branch} branch.

errors.not_connected: This project isn't connected to GitHub yet. A project admin can connect it in Project settings → GitHub.
errors.bad_token: GitHub rejected the token. It may be wrong, expired or revoked.
errors.forbidden: The token isn't allowed to do this. Check its repository access and permissions.
errors.rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unreachable: Plane couldn't reach GitHub. Check the server's internet connection and try again.
errors.repository_not_found: GitHub couldn't find the repository, or the token has no access to it.
errors.branch_not_found: The branch doesn't exist in the repository.
errors.no_push_permission: The token can read the repository but can't push to it, so it can't open pull requests.
errors.no_commits: This branch has no commits that aren't already in the base branch. Push your work first.
errors.pr_exists: A pull request is already open for this branch.
errors.protected_branch: GitHub refused because of the branch's protection rules.
errors.github_error: GitHub returned an unexpected error. Try again.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.step_open: In GitHub, open the repository's Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook.
webhook.step_fill: Paste this URL as the "Payload URL", choose "application/json", and paste the webhook secret.
webhook.step_events: Choose "Let me select individual events" and tick "Pull requests" and "Pushes".
webhook.public_url_note: GitHub must be able to reach this address over the internet. On a local machine, use the replay command instead.

create_pr.title: Create pull request
create_pr.no_branches: No branches found. Push your branch to GitHub first.
create_pr.stale: older than the branch age limit
create_pr.summary: {commits, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} ahead · {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} changed in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
create_pr.old_branch: This branch started {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago, past the {limit}-day limit for trunk-based work. Merge it soon or split the work.
create_pr.large: This pull request changes {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, more than the {limit}-line limit. Consider splitting it into smaller pull requests.
